mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.BRANCH_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID, TS.GOVT_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO as CAR_NO, TN.OWNER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.LINK_ID, TN.NTAX_TRGET_CD FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID WHERE TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TS.PROC_ST = 'P_END' UNION ALL SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.BRANCH_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID, TS.GOVT_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO as CAR_NO, TN.OWNER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.LINK_ID, TN.NTAX_TRGET_CD FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID WHERE TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TS.PROC_ST = 'S_WAIT'
SELECT MEMBER_NM AS SPECIALIST_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(MPHONE_NO) AS SPECIALIST_HP_NO FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID}

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.COMPANY_ID, TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.MEMBER_ID, TCD.CUSTOMER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO AS REQ_CAR_NO FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD, TR_OWNERINFO TOI WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TCD.SERVICE_ID = TOI.SERVICE_ID(+) AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('P_REQ', 'PBEND') AND TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TOI.SEQ = 0

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TN.REQ_CAR_NO, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.COMPANY_ID, TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.MEMBER_ID, TCD.CUSTOMER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO, TP.VBANK_NO AS ACQ_VBANK_NO, TP.PAY_AMT AS ACQ_PAY_AMT FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD, TR_PAYMENT TP, TR_OWNERINFO TOI WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TCD.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND TP.SERVICE_ID = TOI.SERVICE_ID(+) AND TS.PROC_ST NOT IN ('RET', 'DEL', 'END', 'D_CON', 'A_RET', 'P_RET') AND TN.CARD_YN = 'Y' AND TN.CARD_PAY_YN = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TP.PAY_KD = 'ACQ' AND TP.VBANK_NO IS NOT NULL AND TP.PAY_AMT != 0 AND TOI.SEQ = 0

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TS.COMPANY_ID LIKE 'WA%' AND TS.PROC_ST = 'END' AND TS.PROC_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TS.PROC_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND NVL(TN.CARP_SEND_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_BRANCH TB WHERE TB.COMPANY_ID = TS.COMPANY_ID AND TB.BRANCH_ID = TS.BRANCH_ID AND TB.CARP_MAIL_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY TS.PROC_DT, TS.SERVICE_ID

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TN.TASK_CD, TN.PROC_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.LINK_ID, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE, TN.PAY_ST, TN.TOTAL_AMT, TN.VBANK_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.DSIGN_HP_NO) AS LEASE_HP_NO, TCD.NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID JOIN TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD ON TCD.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_OWNERINFO TOI ON TOI.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND TOI.SEQ = 0 AND TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND TN.PROC_CD = 'I' WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TN.REQ_CAR_NO IS NULL AND NVL(TS.PROC_ST, '-') NOT IN ('SAV', 'DEL', 'RET') AND TS.JUDGE_ST IS NULL AND TN.REGIST_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(TS.REQUEST_DT) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 ORDER BY TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.SERVICE_ID

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.LINK_ID, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO, TN.CARD_YN, TO_CHAR(TN.TOTAL_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS TOTAL_AMT, TN.VBANK_NO, TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE - 3, 'YY/MM/DD') AS PAY_DEADLINE, TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE - 3, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSURANCE_DEADLINE, TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSURANCE_START_DATE, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO, TC.COMPANY_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TMD.MPHONE_NO) AS SPECIALIST_HP_NO, TO_CHAR(PM.ACQ_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS ACQ_AMT, TO_CHAR(PM.BFEE_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS BFEE_AMT, TO_CHAR(PM.BOND_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS BOND_AMT, TO_CHAR(PM.FEE_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS FEE_AMT, TO_CHAR(PM.INJI_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS INJI_AMT, TO_CHAR(PM.SPARE_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS SPARE_AMT, TO_CHAR(PM.STAMP_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS STAMP_AMT, TO_CHAR(PM.TNUM_AMT, 'FM999,999,999,999') AS TNUM_AMT FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID JOIN TM_COMPANY TC ON TC.COMPANY_ID = TS.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN TM_MEMBER_DT TMD ON TMD.MEMBER_ID = TS.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SERVICE_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'ACQ' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS ACQ_AMT, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'BFEE' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS BFEE_AMT, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'BOND' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS BOND_AMT, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'FEE' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS FEE_AMT, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'INJI' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS INJI_AMT, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'SPARE' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS SPARE_AMT, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'STAMP' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS STAMP_AMT, MAX(CASE WHEN PAY_KD = 'TNUM' THEN PAY_AMT END) AS TNUM_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT GROUP BY SERVICE_ID ) PM ON PM.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TS.COMPANY_ID LIKE 'W%' AND TN.PAY_GB = 'B'
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('P_REQ', 'PBEND') AND NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') != 'Y' AND TRIM(TN.REQ_CAR_NO) IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 AND TN.VBANK_NO IS NOT NULL AND TN.PAY_HP_NO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.SERVICE_ID

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.LINK_ID, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE, TN.PAY_ST FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND ( (TS.JUDGE_ST IS NULL AND NVL(TS.PROC_ST, '-') NOT IN ('SAV', 'RET', 'DEL', 'REJECT', 'END') AND (TN.REQ_CAR_NO IS NULL OR TN.PAY_ST = 'N')) OR (TS.PROC_ST = 'REQ' AND TS.JUDGE_ST = 'S_REQ' AND TN.REQ_CAR_NO IS NULL) ) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) = ( SELECT MAX(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - 2 - D.DAY_OFFSET) FROM ( SELECT LEVEL - 1 AS DAY_OFFSET FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 32 ) D WHERE (TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - 2 - D.DAY_OFFSET) - TRUNC(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - 2 - D.DAY_OFFSET, 'IW') BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND INSTR( ',' || NVL(( SELECT REPLACE(H.DETAIL_NM, ' ', '') FROM TM_CODE H WHERE H.GROUP_ID = 'ETC..' AND H.CODE_ID = 'HOLID' AND ROWNUM = 1 ), '') || ',', ',' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - 2 - D.DAY_OFFSET, 'YYYYMMDD') || ',' ) = 0 ) ORDER BY TS.SERVICE_ID

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.LINK_ID, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND ( (TS.JUDGE_ST IS NULL AND NVL(TS.PROC_ST, '-') NOT IN ('SAV', 'RET', 'DEL', 'REJECT', 'END')) OR (TS.PROC_ST = 'REQ' AND TS.JUDGE_ST = 'S_REQ' AND TN.REQ_CAR_NO IS NULL) ) ORDER BY TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.SERVICE_ID

SELECT CODE_NM FROM ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'TEAMS' AND CODE_ID = 'NEWC' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN START_DT AND END_DT ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(ORDER_NO) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TM_BOARD ( BOARD_ID, BOARD_GB, BOARD_VW, SUBJECT_TX, CONTENT_TX, COMPANY_ID, BOARD_DT, INS_DATE, UPD_DATE ) SELECT 'P-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(SEQ_BOARD_ID.NEXTVAL, 5, '0'), 'T', #{SERVICE_ID}, #{CARID_NO}, #{CONTENT_TX}, #{COMPANY_ID}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, SYSDATE FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_BOARD WHERE BOARD_VW = #{SERVICE_ID} AND CONTENT_TX = #{CONTENT_TX} AND TRUNC(INS_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) )
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_CARNO_DETACH SET NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN = #{TOKEN}, CONFIRM_NO = NULL, NUMPLATE_SELECT_COUNT = 0, NUMPLATE_SELECT_TIME = NULL WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN IS NULL
UPDATE TR_CARNO_DETACH SET NUMPLATE_SELECT_COUNT = 0, NUMPLATE_SELECT_TIME = NULL WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND NUMPLATE_MSG_TOKEN IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NM, COMPANY_ID, BRACNH_ID, MEMBER_GB, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID}
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SERVICE SET PROC_ST = 'S_REQ', JUDGE_ST = 'S_REQ', UPD_DATE = SYSDATE, UPD_USER = 'SCHEDULAR' WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}
